title: Asahina Mafuyu — Ticket Serendipity〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I need to log into Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Now that we're all here, why don't we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, we're all waiting on Amia to finish editing the video.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, yeah, I'm working on it.
The rest of you can talk about when we're gonna have our after-party, since you're so free.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's fine, but I kinda want to hear about the convention you two went to, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, pick some of it and tell us.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We saw that they had a public piano set up, so K and I decided to play something together.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, we played K's song, like we did during Shibuya Festa... And before we realized it, a lot of people had gathered around us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! It's hard not to notice two people playing together.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And the songs K plays are always really pretty.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What did those people do after you finished playing? Nothing weird, I hope.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, that's it?
I was sort of hoping to hear about them swarming you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm glad that they were all polite.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, you said a lot happened. Tell us more. Anything fun or interesting?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <They held a quiz contest during the concert. K and I got every question right.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <They had quite a few questions about chords and double notes played on different instruments. The goal was to identify them.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But plenty of other people also got every question right. I have a feeling that they were meant to be easy to answer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We received some vouchers for one of the shops in the food court...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But we didn't end up using them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, why? Were neither of you hungry?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, after the concert, we met this boy who really liked to play the trumpet...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So he couldn't make it sound good, huh...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <They do say all wind instruments, not just trumpets, can be really hard to play unless you know the right tricks.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We didn't know much about wind instruments either, so we decided to take him over to a booth with a demo area where he could try playing one.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Shiraishi and Aoyagi were working at that booth.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <They knew the manager, and were lending him a hand by helping with the customers.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Really? Toya helping customers?
I would have liked to see that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too! I bet he did a great job of explaining stuff in a really polite manner!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <He did. He even did a tremendous job with the boy we'd brought over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The boy was ready to give up on the trumpet, but Aoyagi convinced him to keep trying. We actually ended up all practicing together.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whenever I go back to school after a while away, he's always there to tell me how far the class has progressed for math and other subjects♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <He even tells me about the things the teachers say are gonna be on upcoming tests, which has been super helpful.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Aren't you relying on him a little too much, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Man, a lot really did happen!
Thanks for telling us, you two! That was really fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Actually, Yuki...
Why don't you tell your dad this story the next time you meet him?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, that's a great idea!
I bet he'd feel a lot better knowing that you're having fun with K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If you feel comfortable, Yuki, then I also think you should try telling him.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I'll try to tell him the next chance I get...>
